launch.rebuild.body: After a {wins}–{losses} season, {school} has to earn the benefit of the doubt again. The first step is putting a more competitive team on the field every Saturday.
{school} went {wins}–{losses} last year. Nobody around this program needs a reminder. This season is about giving people a reason to believe things are moving forward.

launch.return.body: {school} is coming off a {wins}–{losses} season. That is the backdrop for this camp: what carries over, and where does the next step come from?
Last year: {wins}–{losses} for {school}. A new schedule brings a new set of questions. Last season gives us context; it does not give this team any wins.

launch.champion.body: The national champions are back. A new season for the {nickname}. {hashtag}
A championship to defend. A season to attack. {nickname} football. {hashtag}

launch.playoff_return.body: {school} reached the {finish} last season after going {wins}–{losses}. That gives this year a clear measuring stick. Getting back is an expectation; getting further is the challenge.
The last {school} season ended in the {finish}. This is a program that knows the playoff standard now. The interesting part is whether it can meet it again.

launch.conference_defense.body: Conference champions. Ready to write the next chapter. {hashtag}
The {nickname} begin a new season as defending conference champions. {hashtag}

launch.bowl_return.body: {school} follows a {wins}–{losses} season and {bowlResult}. The program has something concrete to build on as the new season approaches.
Last season brought {bowlResult} for {school}. Camp now turns the attention to what this group can add to that foundation.

launch.new_coach.body: First season for {coach} at {school}. There is no record here to fall back on yet. The opener will be the first real look at what this staff wants its team to be.
A new voice at {school}: {coach} begins his first season in charge. The expectations are familiar. The way this team goes about meeting them may look different.

launch.veteran_coach.body: Year {seasonNumber} for {coach} at {school}. There is continuity at the top. Now the question is what this particular roster can do with it.
{coach} enters season {seasonNumber} at {school}. The program knows his approach. This camp is about finding the players who will carry it onto the field.

launch.recruiter.body: {coach} has a recruiting-first background at {school}. That can shape a program over several classes. This season, the conversation turns to how much of that work shows up on Saturdays.
The recruiting work is a central part of {coach}’s approach at {school}. Building relationships gets players in the door; developing the roster is what comes next.

launch.developer.body: Player development is a central part of {coach}’s approach at {school}. Camp is where that reputation meets the next group trying to earn a role.
At {school}, {coach}’s background puts the emphasis on developing talent. The useful camp question: who looks ready to turn that work into a larger role?

launch.coordinator.body: {coordinator} brings a scheme-focused background to the {school} {side}. The opener will tell us more about how that approach fits this year’s personnel.
Watching the {school} {side} this camp with {coordinator} in charge. His background leans toward scheme and matchups; the personnel will determine what that looks like on Saturdays.

launch.battle.body: A {position} pairing to watch at {school}: {first} and {second}. They are close enough in our preseason evaluation that the order should not be treated as settled.
{school} has a close {position} competition on paper between {first} and {second}. Both are near the top of the current depth chart. Camp gives them a chance to separate.

launch.freshman.body: True freshman {position} {playerName} is one to know at {school}. Our preseason evaluation puts him among the more promising newcomers on this roster. Now he has to earn his snaps.
{school} newcomer to keep an eye on: {playerName}, a true freshman {position}. The early evaluation is encouraging. How quickly he can handle a college role is the next question.

launch.breakout.body: Breakout watch at {school}: {classLabel} {position} {playerName}. There is enough talent here to make him interesting before the numbers arrive. A candidate, not a coronation.
{playerName} is a name worth knowing at {school}. The {classLabel} {position} stands out in our preseason evaluation. I want to see how much responsibility he earns early.

launch.senior.body: One more season with my guys. Going to appreciate every bit of this {hashtag}
Last ride with this team. Thankful for everybody who has been part of it. {hashtag}
Senior season. Same love for this place. Let’s make some memories {hashtag}

launch.nil.body: Appreciate the people supporting me on and off the field. Blessed to have these opportunities {hashtag}
Grateful for the support around me. Football gave me a platform and I don’t take that lightly. {hashtag}
A lot to be thankful for on and off the field. Appreciate everyone in my corner {hashtag}

launch.spotlight.body: Preseason All-American recognition for {position} {playerName}. Ready for what’s next. {hashtag}

launch.heisman.body: An early Heisman name to file away: {school} {position} {playerName}. He has the talent to enter that conversation. The production still has to follow.
{school}’s {playerName} belongs on a preseason Heisman watch list. That is a projection, not a ranking. A strong start is how the {position} turns the idea into a real campaign.

launch.darkhorse.body: My unranked team to watch: {school}. Our preseason evaluation likes the roster more than the AP poll does. I’m interested in the gap. Let’s see if the games close it.
{school} starts outside the AP Top 25, but I like the roster enough to keep an eye on them. Plenty of teams want the dark-horse label. This one has a case.

launch.schedule_opportunity.body: None of {school}’s scheduled regular-season opponents appears in the preseason AP Top 25. That is an opening on paper. It is also a snapshot: unranked does not mean harmless.
The preseason AP poll puts no ranked opponents on {school}’s regular-season schedule. There is room to build momentum here. The rankings will move long before this schedule is finished.

launch.transfer.body: {school} has an experienced addition in {position} {playerName}, who recorded production at {formerSchool} last season. That is a different starting point from asking a newcomer to learn college football from scratch.
Offseason roster note for {school}: {playerName} brings last season’s experience from {formerSchool}. The {position} has already produced at the college level. The fit here is the next part to watch.

launch.kickoff.body: Football season is here. Let’s go, {nickname}. {hashtag}
A new season starts now. {nickname}, we’re ready. {hashtag}
The wait is over. {nickname} football is back. {hashtag}

launch.opening_preview.body: Opening-week look at {school} against {opponent}. The first game gives us something camp cannot: a full-speed test against a team with a different plan. Plenty to learn from this one.
{school} gets {opponent} to open the season. Early games are useful precisely because so much is unsettled. I’m watching how quickly each side finds something it can repeat.

launch.venue.body: Opening week at {stadium}. Our house. {nickname} football. {hashtag}
Back at {stadium}. The {nickname} are ready for opening week. {hashtag}

launch.coach_debut.body: The {coach} era at {school} opens against {opponent}. First games rarely answer everything, but this one starts the public evaluation of a new staff.
{school} begins its first season under {coach} against {opponent}. The first look at a new head coach’s team always comes with a longer list of questions.

launch.countdown.body: Our opener: Week {openerWeek}, against {opponent}. The {nickname} are getting closer. {hashtag}

launch.depth.body: {classLabel} {playerName} is listed first at QB on {school}’s current depth chart. That is the order heading into the opener against {opponent}; it is not a guarantee about every snap.
A first-depth-chart note at {school}: {playerName} is at the top of the QB list. The {classLabel} is in line for the opening assignment against {opponent}.

launch.player_opening.body: Football is back. Ready to go with my brothers {hashtag}
Been waiting on this. Appreciate everybody rocking with us. {hashtag}
Season time!! Love this team. Let’s go {hashtag}
Ready for Saturdays again. See y’all soon {hashtag}

launch.player_opening_qb.body: Excited to get this season started with my guys. Appreciate all the support. {hashtag}
A lot of work went into this offseason. Ready to get back out there together {hashtag}
Season is here. Grateful for another opportunity with this team. {hashtag}

launch.favorite.body: My preseason lean in the {conference}: {school}. Our roster-based model puts them at the front of this league. It is a forecast, and the conference schedule gets the final say.
Picking {school} in the {conference} before we see a snap. The roster gives them a real case. I’m not pretending the gap is a trophy.

launch.recruit_watch.body: Definitely watching {school} this opening week. Want to see how they get after it
College football back and {school} is on my screen this week. Ready to watch
Gonna be locked in on {school} this week. Football season finally here

launch.recruit_tag.body: {tagHandle} good luck this season!! gonna be watching {school}
{tagHandle} go do your thing this year. Got {school} on my watch list
Ready to watch {school}. {tagHandle} have a year!!

launch.high_school.body: High school season coming. Ready to get back out there with my guys
Last offseason felt long. Ready to play some football again
Time to go make some memories with my team. Season coming fast

launch.visit.body: Heading to {school} for a visit this opening week. Excited to get around the team
Visit coming up at {school}. Can’t wait to see it for myself
Gonna be at {school} this week. Appreciate the invite!!

launch.dominant_debut.body: {school} opens with a {score} win over {opponent}. That is how you take care of an opener. It is still one game. Both things can be true.
The first {school} result is a {margin}-point win over {opponent}. Time for the internet to skip directly to December. Good start; let’s get a second data point.

launch.close_debut.body: {school} survives {opponent}, {score}. Opening week has already supplied enough stress for a month. A close win counts; it also leaves plenty to examine.
Final: {school} {score} over {opponent}. A one-score opener is a useful reminder that preseason certainty has a very short shelf life.

launch.opening_takeaway.body: {school} starts with a {score} win over {opponent}. We have actual football to discuss now. I’m resisting the urge to turn one result into an entire season, barely.
Opening-week result: {school} over {opponent}, {score}. Encouraging start. Also exactly one game, which is apparently enough for everyone to have a playoff bracket ready.
